title: OpenPlanr design-loop feedback (v1.0.0)
description: The board↔agent file handshake. The board writes feedback.json (Submit / Approve) or feedback-pending.json (Regenerate / Remix / More-like-this) NEXT TO the board HTML; the agent reads it only after the user says they're done in the blocking AskUserQuestion. feedback-pending.json is consumed (deleted) on read. `ratings` and `comments` are keyed by variant id (A, B, …) — dynamic keys, so they are open objects here; value shapes are enforced by lib/design-engine/feedback.mjs. Pins carry normalized 0..1 region coords; the ≤1 upper bound is clamped at write time (the schema subset has no `maximum`).

boardId.description: The board this feedback belongs to (daemon registry id).

publishedAt.description: ISO timestamp the feedback was written by the board.

preferred.description: Variant id the user picked in the approve bar (e.g. "A"). Absent until chosen.

ratings.description: Per-variant star rating 1..5, keyed by variant id.

comments.description: Per-variant free-text comment, keyed by variant id.

regenerated.description: true when this is a feedback-pending.json round (the user asked for another generation pass) rather than a final submit.

regenerateAction.description: Which regeneration the user asked for. Required by code when regenerated=true.

remixSpec.description: Remix instructions, e.g. { layoutFrom: "A", colorsFrom: "B", note }. Open shape; interpreted by the loop procedure.

authors.description: the roster of reviewers who contributed to this board. Each appears once, keyed by display name. Identity is a LOCAL display name + deterministic avatar only — no account, no auth, no PII.

name.description: Reviewer display name (the merge + avatar key).

color.description: Avatar background token/value derived deterministically from the name (e.g. "--avatar-3").

initials.description: 1–2 letter initials shown in the avatar.

lastSeen.description: ISO timestamp the author last contributed.

pins.description: Region annotations — the core of "fix exactly this part".

id.description: stable item id (12-char sha256 hex prefix of author+createdAt+comment). The merge key together with `author`; assigned by normalizeLegacy for legacy items.

author.description: the reviewer who created this pin (display name). Legacy/unattributed items normalize to "Anonymous".

variant.description: Variant id (design-loop) or screen id (design-review) the pin sits on.

x.description: Left edge, normalized 0..1 of the variant's rendered box.

w.description: Width, normalized 0..1 (0 for a point pin).

h.description: Height, normalized 0..1 (0 for a point pin).

comment.description: What the user wants done here.

intent.description: How the agent should treat the pin.

status.description: lifecycle of the pin as tracked feedback. Defaults to "open" when absent.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp the pin was created (also feeds the stable id).

screen.description: design-review only: the artifact screen/section id the pin maps to (e.g. "s-dashboard").

replies.description: short threaded replies on this pin so feedback is a tracked conversation, not a write-once note.

id.description: optional stable reply id (the reply-level merge key). Absent on legacy/optimistic replies; mergeFeedback() falls back to a content signature (author+comment+createdAt) so the append/dedup stays idempotent without it.

author.description: Reviewer who wrote the reply (display name).

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp the reply was written.
